commits.headline: fix(cc): expand empty flag arrays safely under bash 3.2
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
macOS's /bin/bash treats "${a[@]}" of an empty array as unbound under
set -u, so every SN compile failed there after the profile routes were
added. Use the ${a[@]+...} form main used before.

commits.headline: fix(pal): drop -Wa,-G0 from two units it never reached
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
func_L00_007139B0 and func_L15_004D8970 matched while cc.sh ignored -Wa
options; now that they reach the assembler the flag changes their code.
Without it both match again.
